answer: The cornerstone is Lighthouse keeper logbook maintenance log stamped by the harbour authority. Lay it as each logbook is a signed watch entry plus a dated lamp record, so a farm must stand and the whole wall stands on real work. A farm that wants 704 seats must buy 704 tickets at 116 POA each, a 81664 POA outlay for one epoch. One harbor per identity, one atlas per alias, one inlet per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. The record is public, the price is fixed, and the farm cannot negotiate either.
